Shia LaBeouf Allegedly Disturbing New Orleans Tennis Club Members Getty Composite Jack Osbourne named his newborn baby girl after his late father. Ozzy Osbourne's son just posted a video of the child on Instagram and it shows her full name is Ozzy Matilda Osbourne. Jack's daughter was born March 5 at 8:49 AM and she weighed 7 pounds and 12 ounces and checked in at 19 inches in length. As you know ... Ozzy died back in July. He knew he was going to be a grandpa again before his death. Jack and his wife, Aree Earhart, now have two kids together ... and this is the fifth child for Jack overall. Congrats!!!
